regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, article metadata, and ESI/CCDC footnote

Classified the multi-route conversion of CO2 to oxazolidinones as cited prior-literature context, not a present-paper experiment.

Split the two current generic arrows into CO2/NIS-to-iodoallenyl-oxazolidinone and CS2-to-allenyl-thiazolidine-thione general schemes. Concrete scope runs appear in Tables 1 and 2.

unresolved: Scheme 1 contains generic R/Nu groups and cannot define unique experiment-specific structures or quantities.
The publisher ESI statement and CCDC deposition do not establish an associated workspace SI file.

regions.finding: Recorded the DBU/NIS/CO2/CHCl3 model run (2a, 28%, 1:1 dr) and the distinct TBD base-screen result (2a, 48% isolated, 3:1 dr). The unassociated Table S1 was not reconstructed; the best 4:1 toluene/1,4-dioxane solvent statement is linked as context only.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 reaction header, 18-product grid, caption, and footnote a
regions.finding: All 18 displayed 2a–2r scope rows were recorded independently with the shared two-stage operation: 10 min pre-stir under 1 atm CO2, then NIS addition and a 12–24 h CO2-balloon hold at room temperature. Each row retains its printed yield and dr.

regions.region: page 2 lower scope discussion and limitations
regions.finding: Mapped the prose to Table 1 rows and retained two no-desired-product classes (aryl substitution and strongly electron-withdrawing N-substitution) plus the internal-alkyne 1,2/1,4-addition mixture as unresolved current-paper outcomes without importing ESI structures.
The page introduces the distinct CS2 model reaction; its quantified 96%/4 h outcome continues on page 3 and is recorded there rather than duplicated here.

unresolved: Table S1 is not associated, so exact optimization quantities/times and the entry-25 numeric outcome remain unavailable.
Table 1 assigns only a 12–24 h shared range, not product-specific exact times.
Failure-class substrate identities, detection limits, and side products are not specified in the main text.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 2 reaction header, 24-product grid, caption, footnotes a–b, and CCDC graphic
regions.finding: All 24 displayed 3a–3x scope rows were recorded independently. Standard rows retain 0.1 mmol substrate/TBD 0.15 mmol/CHCl3 1 mL/CS2 0.3 mmol/room temperature/2–4 h. Footnote-b row 3v retains 0.3 mmol substrate, DBU 3 equiv, CS2 3 equiv, and 12 h without inventing a scaled CS2 mmol charge. CCDC 2348815 characterizes 3o only.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left and right-column scope prose
regions.finding: Recorded the separate main-text model optimization (3a, 96%, 4 h) while Table 2 3a remains 93%. The prose-mapped 3u/3v low outcomes and 3w/3x yields are retained, and unspecified 1,2-addition side products remain one unresolved observation tied to no inferred SI structures.
Recorded the independent 5 mmol 1o scale-up to 3o (1.02 g, 64%, >20:1 dr, 4 h), distinct from the 0.1 mmol Table 2 3o row (76%).

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Scheme 2b three post-modification arrows
regions.finding: Recorded three separate operations: 3o/NaH/dimethyl malonate to 4 (71%, 1.2:1 dr); 3o/FeCl3/MeMgBr at -78 °C to 5 (65%, 9:1 dr); and 2d/Pd(PPh3)4/phenylboronic acid/Ag2O to 6 (67%, 4.5:1 dr). The prose calls the first Pd-catalyzed while the arrow omits Pd identity/loading, and that omission remains explicit.
